title: 第14章 大收获

content_zh:
没多大功夫，除了方行自己带走的灵石之外，其他人仅剩的物件便都互相调换了一下。
然后方行才拍了拍手，来到大耗子精面前，二话不说，噼哩啪啦抽了一通。
“他奶奶的，让你讹诈老子，今天要好好教训你！”
迷烟效果很好，方行打的手都麻了，眼见瘦耗子精已经变成了肿耗子精，他还没有醒来。
想想还不解恨，方行又解开裤带，在大耗子精脸上撒了泡尿，看着他鼻青脸肿，凄惨兮兮的模样，这才满意的点了点头，大摇大摆的离开了。
山谷清幽，宿鸟不鸣，月光清皎，山谷之中，横七竖八倒了一片的人。
足足过了一个时辰左右，修为最深的大耗子精才率先醒了过来，他用力摇了摇脑袋，这才想起发生了什么事情，猛一哆嗦，便伸手去摸自己怀里的金子，立时发现自己用六块灵石换来的四百八十两金叶子全都不见了，顿时哀豪了一声，不过嚎声嘎然而止……
因为他很快就发现，发现自己怀里没了金叶子，却多了一柄飞剑。
取出来一看，乃是一柄下品飞剑，算成金子，也能卖千两银子左右，比起自己丢失了的金子，倒还赚了，他一时想不明白这飞剑怎么到了自己怀里，不过已经到手的东西，自然不可能再吐出去了，立刻收好，然后向四周一打量，老鼠眼骨碌骨碌的转……
见众人还在熟睡，他飞快的从旁边几人手里拿了点好东西，忙不迭塞进自己怀里。
见那几个灵动二重的弟子身体微微一动，似乎快要醒来了，他才蹑手蹑脚的飞快溜掉了。
余下人醒来，面面相觑，第一个反应也是去检查自己的东西，很快就发现，所有的灵石全部丢掉了，但怀里却多了一些不属于自己的物件。
这几人本想声张出来，却忽然想到，这时候把东西交出来孰为不智。
自己声张出来了，万一被失主讨回去了，自己可是一点东西都不剩，毕竟自己的东西，要么被贼人偷走了，要么就在别人怀里，被贼人偷走了，那是无论如何也讨不回来，而若是在旁人怀里，那人不声张的话，自己却是白白吃了一个亏，啥都落不下……
因此，想通了这一节之后，众人竟然奇异的都保持了沉默，悄然离开了。
有机会的，还趁机拿了一些别人的东西，这也就导致，越晚醒来的人越倒楣，当那个洞天指环与九蛇金炎剑全部都被盗走的肥羊醒来的时候，几乎欲哭无泪，他可是损失最惨重的一个，但是这个时候，除了他自己之外，场间就只剩了几个和他一样一贫如洗的穷鬼了……
“到底是谁干的？我洛西和你势不两立！”
悲痛的叫声撕裂了晨曦的寂静，惊飞了一群刚刚归巢的飞鸟。
而这个时候，那一个罪该万死的大盗，已经回到了山谷，正笑的合不拢嘴。
发了，确实发了一笔小财啊！

方行回来之后就清点过了，灵石足足三十多块，几乎是自己七八年时间领取的总数了，这还不算那贮物戒指与那柄九蛇金炎剑，贮物戒指他已经查看过了，以那个年青肥羊的修为，还没有能力在贮物戒指上打下烙印，因此方行很容易就将它往里面一瞅，方行立刻笑的咧开了嘴。
幸运的不得了，里面除了九蛇金炎剑，竟然还有一些易筋洗髓的灵药与几十两金叶子，一下子把自己修行加生活的困难全部解决了，从赤贫直奔小康……
尤其是那柄飞剑，赤红色的剑身，上面镶嵌着九条栩栩如生的金色小蛇，非常的逼真，便好像是九条小蛇盘在剑身上休眠，随时都会醒过来噬人……
光这外表就很不凡呐！
用阴阳神魔鉴看了一下，方行赫然发现这飞剑之中，足有九个铭刻精密的法阵。
这材质，这做工，再加上里面明显比其他飞剑高出一个档次的法阵，乖乖得不得了。
不愧是价值万两黄金的宝贝！
不过方行试着摧动了一下，却发现这飞剑简直像个无底洞，自己的灵气根本不够用，他这时也才明白了过来，难怪那个肥羊要用这飞剑去换灵石，因为这飞剑根本就不是灵动一重的弟子可以用的，其品质太高，恐怕至少也得真次二重甚至三重，才能运用。

content_en:
Without much effort, except for the spirit stones that Fang Xing took away, the remaining objects were exchanged with each other.
Then Fang Xingcai clapped his hands, came to the big rat spirit, and without saying a word, he smacked him.
"His grandma asked you to blackmail me, and I will teach you a lesson today!"
The effect of the smoke was very good. Fang Xing's hands were numb after being hit. He saw that the thin rat spirit had turned into a swollen rat spirit. He hadn't woken up yet.
After thinking about it, he still couldn't understand his hatred, so Fang Xing untied his belt again and peed on the big rat's face. Seeing his miserable appearance with bruises and swollen face, Fang Xing nodded with satisfaction and left in a swaggering manner.
The valley is quiet, the birds are silent, and the moonlight is bright. In the valley, there are people scattered everywhere.
After about an hour, the big rat spirit with the deepest cultivation was the first to wake up. He shook his head vigorously and then remembered what happened. He shivered violently and reached out to touch the gold in his arms. He immediately found that all the 482 gold leaves he had exchanged for six spiritual stones were gone. He suddenly let out a mournful cry, but the howling suddenly stopped...
Because he soon discovered that instead of the golden leaf, he had a flying sword in his arms.
When he took it out, he saw that it was a low-grade flying sword. It was considered gold and could be sold for about a thousand taels of silver. Compared with the gold he lost, he still made a profit. He couldn't figure out how the flying sword got into his arms for a moment, but it was naturally impossible to spit out what he had already got. He put it away immediately, and then looked around, and the mouse's eyes were turning...
Seeing that everyone was still sleeping soundly, he quickly grabbed some good things from the hands of the people next to him and hurriedly stuffed them into his arms.
Seeing that the disciples of the second level of agility moved slightly, as if they were about to wake up, he quickly slipped away.
The rest of the people woke up and looked at each other in confusion. Their first reaction was to check their own things. They soon discovered that all the spirit stones were lost, but there were some items in their arms that did not belong to them.
These people wanted to speak out, but suddenly thought that it would be unwise to hand over the things at this time.
I have spoken out, but if the owner takes it back, I will have nothing left. After all, my things are either stolen by thieves, or are stolen by thieves in the arms of others, and they cannot get them back anyway. But if they are in the arms of others and that person does not say anything, I will suffer a loss in vain and lose nothing...
Therefore, after thinking about this section, everyone strangely remained silent and left quietly.
When there was a chance, they took the opportunity to take some other people's things, which also led to the later people wake up, the more unlucky they are. When the fat sheep who had the Cave Heaven Ring and the Nine Snakes Golden Flame Sword were stolen woke up, he almost cried without tears. He was the one who suffered the most losses. But at this time, apart from himself, there were only a few poor ghosts left in the room who were as impoverished as him...
"Who did it? I, Luo Xi, are at odds with you!"
The mournful cries tore through the silence of the morning light, frightening a flock of birds that had just returned to their nests.
At this time, the thief who deserved death had returned to the valley and was smiling from ear to ear.
I made a fortune, I did make a small fortune!
After Fang Xing came back, he counted it. There were more than thirty spiritual stones, which was almost the total amount he had received in seven or eight years. This did not include the storage ring and the Nine Snakes Golden Flame Sword. He had already checked the storage ring. With the cultivation of the young fat sheep, he was not able to put a mark on the storage ring, so Fang Xing easily took a look inside, and Fang Xing immediately grinned.
I was very lucky. In addition to the Nine Snakes Golden Flame Sword, there were also some marrow-removing elixirs and dozens of gold leaves. All the difficulties in my practice and life were solved at once.From extreme poverty to well-off society...
Especially the flying sword, the red sword body is inlaid with nine lifelike little golden snakes. It is very lifelike, as if the nine little snakes are coiled around the sword and sleeping, and they will wake up and bite people at any time...
This appearance alone is extraordinary!
After checking it with the Yin-Yang God and Demon Jian, Fang Xing suddenly discovered that there were nine precisely engraved magic circles in the flying sword.
This material, this workmanship, plus the magic circle inside is obviously a level higher than other flying swords, it's so good.
It is indeed a treasure worth ten thousand taels of gold!
However, Fang Xing tried to destroy it, but found that the flying sword was like a bottomless pit, and his spiritual energy was not enough. He realized it at this time. No wonder the fat sheep wanted to use this flying sword to exchange for spiritual stones, because this flying sword could not be used by disciples of the first level of agility.
